summary.zh: 把代码评审笔记整理成双栏网页报告
summary.en: Turn markdown code reviews into a two-column HTML report

description.zh: 把带有 diff 片段和严重程度标注的 markdown 代码评审转成双栏 HTML 报告，左右对照查看改动与说明。适合评审结束后需要一份易读、可存档的结果时使用。转换时要指定评审人姓名，并先设定品牌样式。
description.en: Turns a markdown code review with diff blocks and severity callouts into a two-column HTML report. Good when a review must be readable and archivable. A named reviewer and brand styles are required.
